intro: Built on free software (open source except the Remotion slide renderer, which is proprietary source-available under its Free License). Licenses below were read from the installed packages (two voice packages, phonemizer-fork and eSpeak NG, are GPL and are installed by pip, never bundled in this repository); run scripts/list_licenses.py to re-check.

items.name: Meta Model API — Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0
